notes: 11.0.0 is the full 0.1.156 catch up. New: Character rotation cycles your characters after equal farming time and keeps each one's own skills and settings. Orbit while clearing batch circles the pack instead of walking off it. Grand Cross can cast on every cooldown with no enemy nearby. Whispers and trade requests can take a Steam screenshot. The game restarts if the inventory stays busy. The top bar gains a channel control and a Scheduled AFK countdown, and the Overview gains Farm gold and Bag gold. Fixes to overweight travel, the grenade cast window, and Loot List. Every new setting is off until you turn it on.
